About IBSC

Communication across cultures

Established in 2017, Yuan Ze University’s International Bachelor in Strategic Communication prepares students to communicate with purpose in a multilingual, multicultural world.

On this page
Our storyYuan Ze UniversityContact & visitProgram resources

A program for a connected world

Taught entirely in English, IBSC brings together perspectives from the humanities, social sciences, design and business. Students develop the communication skills, practical experience and global outlook to find their strengths and shape their next chapter.

Founded in 2017, IBSC is part of Yuan Ze University’s College of Humanities and Social Sciences. The program was formerly known as EBSC.

A global classroom

Learn in an English-taught environment alongside students and faculty from different cultural backgrounds.

Ideas into practice

Connect classroom learning with interdisciplinary projects, internships and opportunities to study abroad.

People behind the program

Meet the faculty and staff who support learning, inquiry and student development.

Our university

Yuan Ze University

Established in 1989, Yuan Ze University is home to IBSC and a community that connects the humanities, technology, and professional practice.

A wider community of learning

Yuan Ze University is in Zhongli District, Taoyuan City, Taiwan. Its academic community spans engineering, informatics, management, humanities and social sciences, and electrical and communications engineering.

IBSC belongs to the College of Humanities and Social Sciences. Learning brings together perspectives from languages, design, social and policy sciences, and business.

The university supports international experiences, industry connections, and opportunities for students to develop their interests beyond the classroom.
